text.description_html:
Schlage Control Key for Conventional "C" Keyway I/C Core

For use with Schlage full sized I/C core. Standard Schlage 6 Pin "C" Keyway.

* Control keys are cut to fit. Sold only with the purchase of a lock cylinder.
